architecture.description: The CPU architecture that the image is built for (e.g. x86_64, arm64).

created_time.description: Timestamp of when this image was created

hash.description: The unique hash of the image

in_use_count.description: Number of containers using this image

last_used_time.description: Timestamp of when this image was last used

modified_time.description: Timestamp of when this image was last modified

platform.description: The operating system platform of the image (e.g. AMAZON_LINUX_2).

registry_uid.description: The unique identifier of the registry where this image is stored

repository_name.description: Name of the repository containing this image
